Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely anchored on the 2025 Louise album “Confessions” from the initial SERP and did not disambiguate the widely known 2004 Usher album. This ignored contextual clues in the question (lead single and an eight-week block) that point to Usher’s “Yeah!” and the eight-week No. 2 run of Mario Winans’ “I Don’t Wanna Know.” This misdirection led to irrelevant searches and delayed identifying the correct singer (Usher).
